method: Azure-proposed narrow corrections inspected by Codex before application; acceptance requires a fresh separate review.

patches.old:
“I am the shepherd, the messenger of repentance. I have shown and spoken to God’s servant[b] all the things written above. Believe and listen to my words. Follow them and correct your ways. Then you will be able to live. But anyone who keeps doing evil and holding grudges will not live to God. I have told you everything I was to say.”

2. The shepherd asked me, “Have you asked me everything?” “Yes, sir,” I said. “Then why did you not ask about the marks on the stones in the building? Why did you not ask why we filled in those marks?[a]” “I forgot, sir,” I said.

3. He said, “Now hear about them. These people have now heard my commandments and repented with all their hearts. The Lord saw that their repentance was good and pure and that they could keep to it. So he ordered their former sins to be erased. The marks were their sins. They were smoothed away so they would not appear.”
patches.new:
“I am the shepherd, the messenger of repentance. I have shown and spoken to God’s servant[b] all the things written above. So if you believe, listen to my words, follow them and correct your ways, you will be able to live. But anyone who keeps doing evil and holding grudges will not live to God. I have told you everything I was to say.”

2. The shepherd himself asked me, “Have you asked me everything?” “Yes, sir,” I said. “Then why did you not ask about the marks on the stones in the building? Why did you not ask why we filled in those marks?[a]” “I forgot, sir,” I said.

3. He said, “Now hear about them. These people have now heard my commandments and repented with all their hearts. The Lord saw that their repentance was good and pure and that they could keep to it. So he ordered their former sins to be erased. The marks were their sins. They were smoothed away so they would not appear.”
patches.reason: The supplied Latin places belief, hearing, walking in the words and correcting one's ways together under si, with vivere poteritis as the consequence; restore that explicit condition rather than independent commands. Separately, ipse in ait mihi ipse pastor explicitly emphasizes the shepherd himself; restore that emphasis. Existing paragraph divisions, markers and the disclosed singular servant reading are preserved.

patches.old: Shorter sentences preserve the shepherd’s authority, ethical scope, blood-guilt and remedy language, and all noted alternatives.
patches.new: Shorter sentences preserve the shepherd’s authority and speaker emphasis, the conditions for life, the warning against persistent evil and grudges, wholehearted repentance, the Lord’s assessment and the erasure of former sins, with all noted alternatives retained.
patches.reason: This unit contains no blood-guilt assertion. Replace that inaccurate metadata claim with features present in the supplied Latin and retained in the corrected translation, including the conditional construction and ipse emphasis.

translation:

    these things written above. If, then, you believe, listen to my words, walk in them and correct your
    ways, you will be able to live. But if you persist in wickedness and grudges, no one of that kind
    will live to God. I have told you everything I was to say.”


    2. The shepherd himself said to me, “Have you asked me everything?” I said, “Yes, sir.” “Why, then,
    did you not ask me about the marks on the stones placed in the structure, and why we filled in those
    marks?[a]” I said, “I forgot, sir.”

    with all their hearts. When the Lord saw that their repentance was good and pure and that they could
    remain in it, he ordered their former sins to be erased. These marks were their sins, and they were
    smoothed away so they would not appear.”'

      molds are introduced.
  - marker: b
    reason: textual_variant
